dataPolicy: Original 762-trial CSV is the historical baseline. A registry link is not proof of original FDA PDUFA evidence or of a clinical effect. Pending remains pending, never imputed.

manufacturerEvidence.scope: Company announced five ongoing late-stage products: HFMD2, HFMD4, PCV13, MCV4 and HmAb-TT; also China NMPA HFMD2 application review. These are not US FDA NDA/PDUFA determinations.
Company announced Phase IIIa HFMD4 study initiation. Maps to NCT07611513 by vaccine type, trial phase, age group and original registry design; no published efficacy outcome.
Company 2025 Form 20-F says Nasdaq trading of common shares halted since February 22, 2019; no date for resumption guaranteed. Listed status does not establish investable stock trading.
Nasdaq filing compliance restored; this must not be confused with trading-halt removal.

nextResearch: Thirteen trial outcomes remain unadjudicated. Pursue original published protocol-specific results; distinguish ongoing trials, no public final readout, and missing source evidence.
